metallum.options.metalfx.mode.tooltip: Select native rendering, spatial upscaling, temporal upscaling, or automatic capability selection. Changes apply immediately.
metallum.options.metalfx.scale.tooltip: Render the 3D scene at this fraction of the display resolution before MetalFX upscaling. Changes apply immediately.
metallum.options.metalfx.reactive_mask.t: Reject temporal history where glass, water, particles, weather, clouds, and other transparent targets contribute to the image.
metallum.options.metalfx.frame_generatio: Generate an interpolated frame between rendered frames on supported macOS systems. Changes apply when the settings screen closes.
metallum.options.metal_hud.tooltip: Show Apple's Metal performance overlay. Restart the game after changing this option.
metallum.options.metalfx.profile.tooltip: Switch MetalFX between Off, Frame Generation, Upscaling, and Full Power. Changes apply immediately.
